glossary._note: Simplified Chinese. Fixed terms every Chinese page must use. Brand 'uvaindex.org' and the abbreviations UVA, UVB, UVC, UV, SPF, PA, nm, W/m² stay in Latin script.

glossary.tone: Clear, natural Simplified Chinese for a general audience. Full-width Chinese punctuation (，。：；（）“”) in prose; keep numbers, units and Latin abbreviations half-width, with a space between Chinese characters and Latin words/numbers (e.g. 'UVA 指数', '约 95%').
